notes.c9cdbd13e54920f9: False positive — app/src/lib/adsCredentials.js. The scanner matches the string literals 'google_ads_developer_token' and 'gads_developer_token', which are a keychain provider id and a sessionStorage key, not secret values. The file reads tokens from the OS keychain or sessionStorage and never embeds one. Verified 2026-08-20; a full-history scan of all 434 revisions found no live credentials anywhere in the repo.

maintenance: Only CRITICAL findings block CI, so only verified-false-positive criticals belong here. Add entries by hand with a note rather than running --write-baseline, which overwrites this file with every current finding and would silently suppress real HIGH/MEDIUM issues.
